author: Numberz_
body:
Hey,
I'm wondering how the retirement policy works on Avicus. From what I was told if you retired a few months ago you had to work your way up from Jr. Mod. Did this change again? Cause I noticed that Newcles was promoted directly from user to Sr. Mod after he retired from the position a few months ago. While Iron on the other, had to start at Jr. Mod and work his way up. Seems a little unfair to me. I thought that the 1-2 week Jr. Mod trial was necessary? Any information about this would be appreciated. ;p 

Thanks, 
Numberz

title: How does the retirement policy work? @admins

replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body:
Hey there, Numberz.


The retirement policy is this; “If a mod would like to end their responsibility of moderating, they must have 3 months as service to eligible for the retirement rank. They must of also achieved a higher rank than junior mod.” Some exceptions are made in some cases, but I’ll assure you that they were made for a good reason, thanks for your concern!
